description: Use when a claim is high-stakes, or when check_answer or extract_claims marks it unsure (their next_step gives the exact request). Verifies up to three claims against Wikipedia, Wikidata, Google News, Europe PMC, FRED and SEC EDGAR; returns verdict, confidence, evidence for and against with URLs, and flags contradictions. Async: poll GET /v1/jobs/{job_id} free. $0.75 USDC on Base via x402. Read-only.

answer.description: The claim or short text to verify (up to three claims are checked).

sources.description: Optional. Up to 10 sources of your own, used as extra evidence next to the public sources and cited with provider and source_type "caller". The response lists what was used in sources_used.

items.description: One source: {url} for a public https page we fetch, or {text, title?, url?} for text you already have.

text.description: Source text to check the claim against (up to 20,000 characters). When given, no fetch is made.

url.description: Public https URL. Fetched with a 3.5 s timeout and a 512 KB cap; http, file and other schemes, private / loopback / link-local / metadata addresses, IP-literal hosts, custom ports and URLs with credentials are rejected (HTTP 400, not charged). With text, it is only the citation link.

sources_only.description: Optional. true = judge the claim only against your sources (no public-source lookups). Needs a non-empty sources array.

name: deep_verify

payment.description: Payment instructions. MCP tools/call does not charge or run the paid work; call the HTTP route with x402.

amount.description: Price in USDC base units (6 decimals).

body.description: JSON body to POST (the tool arguments you sent).

method.description: HTTP method for the paid route.

price.description: Price in USD, paid as USDC.

result.description: Paid result: { mode: 'deep', status: 'queued', job_id, receipt }. Poll GET /v1/jobs/{job_id} for { verdict, confidence, contradiction, evidence_for[], evidence_against[], citations[] }.

status.description: payment_required: pay the HTTP route with x402 to get the result. ok: result is included.

title: Deep verify
